comments.body:
I got broken builds on `x86_64-linux`

`/lib/services/lib.nix` does not exist in `nixos-25.11` branch of `nixpkgs`.

as far as I can tell `nixpkgs-unstable` has this path, so it's breaking stable and everything older.

Thanks for the report.

This looks like a branch mismatch rather than a supported compatibility issue. Home Manager `master` tracks unstable nixpkgs, and is not expected to work with stable release branches such as `nixos-25.11`.

Please use the Home Manager branch that matches the nixpkgs branch used to evaluate your configuration. For `nixos-25.11`, that means `home-manager/release-25.11`. If you want to follow Home Manager `master`, nixpkgs should follow `nixpkgs-unstable` / `nixos-unstable` as well.

Closing as unsupported configuration. If this still reproduces with matching Home Manager and nixpkgs branches, please reopen  with the exact revisions and a minimal reproduction.
